title: Can you ANSWER these 3 questions.
transcript: figure out what it is you actually want to build. Now, this is the most important [music] phase because especially when you're writing code with AI, you really need to know what you actually want. If you don't know what the finished product should look like, it's going to be very difficult to build that and AI can completely go rogue and really get off the rails. So, there's three main questions that you need to be able to answer [music] at this stage. The first question is what problem is my application going to [music] solve? You need to figure out what that problem is and be able to state that clearly in just one sentence. Now, question number two, >> [music] >> who is this for? Is it you? Is it your mom? Is it students? Is it a doctor? It doesn't matter, but you need to know who the key user is because that's going to allow you to plan it out a lot better. And then question three, >> [music] >> what does done mean? Does this mean that you can upload a PDF and you get an AI analysis for it? Does this mean that 100 doctors are using your application or it's fully deployed so anyone around the world can use it? If you can answer those three questions, you already have a pretty good sense of what it is that you want [music] to build.
